source.paper: Calonico, S., Cattaneo, M. D., Farrell, M. H. and Titiunik, R. (2017). rdrobust: Software for regression-discontinuity designs. The Stata Journal 17(2), 372-404. Data from Cattaneo, M. D., Frandsen, B. and Titiunik, R. (2015), Journal of Causal Inference 3(1), 1-24.

source.data_check: The pinned CSV (sha256 def1fc6b...a2ad44) has 1,390 rows, 1,297 with both vote and margin, matching the paper. Python rdrobust 2.1.1 with defaults gave 7.4141 (SE 1.4587), robust CI [4.0937, 10.9193], h = 17.754 (checked 2026-11-19). The small difference from the paper is the bandwidth selector's version drift.
